audit.whatIsWrong: The chart says Warwick or Skill through levels 2-5 and first item while every why-string beside it says Kled takes over from level 2 onward. The packet chart and the mirror audit both say Kled.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Warwick, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled]; the mirror (kled__warwick) set Level 1 to Warwick, Level 2 / Level 3 / Levels 4-5 / First item to Kled, and kept Level 6 as Skill and 2+ items as Warwick. 49.45% winrate over 271 games fits a lane you only win at level 1 and again with two items.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped on both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings; rows 4 and 6 left as the mirror has them.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — the packet reports zero sequencing cues, and breakdown.cooldowns is pure boilerplate that names no Warwick ability.
audit.why: The concrete numbers are Bear Trap on a Rope at 11s rank 1, Violent Tendencies at 13s rank 1, Jousting at 13s rank 1, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! at 140s rank 1, against your Primal Howl at 15s and Infinite Duress at 110s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten to name Bear Trap's 11s, Primal Howl's 15s and Infinite Duress' 110s, with what each is for.

audit.whatIsWrong: Infinite Duress described as a 'point-and-click fight starter' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late, and Primal Howl appears nowhere despite being the ability that answers his burst.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a directional leap suppressing the first champion collided with for 1.5s, flagged as an interruptible channel. Violent Tendencies is a four-attack attack-speed burst with the fourth hit amplified — Primal Howl's 2.5s of damage reduction ending in a 1s flee is what breaks that sequence, and it is missing from the whole page.
audit.corrected: R restated as a leap; Primal Howl named with its 15s cooldown and tied to the Violent Tendencies burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Let him remount' but its body is generic cooldown filler about burning an ability.
audit.why: Skaarl's courage is restored by fighting enemies, and remounting returns a portion of Skaarl's health — so the actual mistake is trading with a dismounted Kled until he remounts.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to state the real mistake.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion it hits for 1.5s, but Chaaaaaaaarge!!! hands him a shield and a charge to survive it — ult with your jungler.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Kled carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion in its path for 1.5s — spend it on his commit, not his engage. Kled carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — his hook, 11s at rank 1. Dodge it and the trade is yours. - Primal Howl (15s): fear him out of the Violent Tendencies four-attack burst. - Infinite Duress (110s): kill windows only.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Fighting dismounted Kled to full courage hands Skaarl's health back.

notes: report[8].t prescribes 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern', but nothing in Kled's kit text is a heal: courage restores Skaarl and remounting returns a portion of Skaarl's health, which anti-heal does not obviously touch. I did not edit it because I cannot verify from the kits whether Grievous Wounds reduces the remount restore. Also unresolved and unwritten: whether tenacity or Cleanse shorten Primal Howl's flee, the same gap the mirror auditor recorded.
